render-spend-trajectory.ref: reelPipeline.ts (2026-10-08, after #2934, subject-free hold + typed refusals): enqueueReelJob refuses a beat whose visual names no object (shotRouter.beatGenerationRoute 'needs_subject') at the same point as a declared real/deterministic beat, BEFORE requestReservation (blocked at enqueue, nothing reserved), and processNextReelJob holds it after the queued claim and BEFORE selectReelVideoProvider / generateReelClipVideo, releasing the reservation (unchanged branch, refusedJobReservation.test.ts drives the real processNextReelJob through it). The four content refusals inside enqueueReelJob (condemned script, ungeneratable beat, episode contract, over-long caption) now throw ReelPreflightBlockedError, which dailyReelPost's enqueue catch types to advance the rotation; a bare Error there rethrew and would have failed the cron at every production hour without moving the cursor. Tests: server/reelEnqueueRefusalAdvance.test.ts (11: only infrastructure faults throw a bare Error inside enqueueReelJob, with a planted bare-Error control the scan catches), server/declaredSourceAtGeneration.test.ts (5: the typed throw is pinned before the reservation; the generation-stage order claim < check < provider < generate), shared/shotRouter.test.ts (21: all ten placeholder shots held, controls naming a part generate, declarations decide first, the hold line), server/approvedReelPackRotation.test.ts (20: over every pack directory the subject-free packs are exactly 34, all beats held, none in the rotation, each excluded with the reason), server/refusedJobReservation.test.ts (4, unchanged, passing), server/selectiveRepair.test.ts (9: single-beat repair refuses a real, a deterministic and a placeholder beat before any spend check or write, with a plain-prose control that queues; mutation narrowing the guard to the two declared routes red 1 of 9). Mutations, each red then restored byte-identical: detector always false (3 red), the enqueue hold back to a bare Error (3 red), a subject-free pack re-appended to the rotation (1 red). Same PR, later (pack-build experiments): enqueueReelJob also forwards the brief's appliedPackArms to assignEpisodeToActiveExperiment after the job row exists, which touches no refusal, reservation or provider step. The brief-level refusals above now live in one helper, server/services/reelEnqueueRefusals.briefEnqueueRefusals (preflight, condemned script, ungeneratable beats, caption and hashtag limits), which the miner's brief loop (reelDraftPrep.prepareCleanReelBrief) runs so it regenerates instead of losing the day at enqueue (server/reelDraftPrep.test.ts: a placeholder-beat brief and an unsafe-claim brief are regenerated past; mutation dropping the two checks red), and which a pack variant must clear for every arm before it can be built (server/packVariantExperiment.test.ts). No variant is approved, so today's spend trajectory is the base pack's.
